decisions.reason: The source requests temporary material-treatment comparisons involving the second V but does not change its geometry, hierarchy, construction, or revision policy.
Applying champagne gold to the accent in one comparison option does not change its Hero-V derivation, vector geometry, alignment, or locked-asset policy.
The requested side-by-side material renderings do not change the wordmark's spacing, baseline, scale, case treatment, or composition rhythm.
The source applies alternative finishes to the existing Hero V right arm without changing the approved Hero V geometry or its role as the fixed foundation.
Keeping non-signature elements black in the comparison is a material-distribution choice and does not alter the construction or architectural language of the letterforms.
The comparison colors the signature terminals but does not change their shared gesture, structural design, or terminal-conclusion constraints.
The preference for warm and sophisticated finish candidates is consistent with the existing brand-expression requirements and does not revise them.
Material-treatment comparisons within the wordmark do not introduce a separate icon or monogram or otherwise change the wordmark-led identity architecture.
